01 — About Me

Building my skills one real project at a time.

I’m Hanzla Arshad, a BS Computer Science student. I started my degree in 2024 and expect to complete it in 2028.

Alongside university studies, I work on practical programming projects to turn concepts into working software. My current foundation includes C++, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, Git and GitHub.

I am focused on becoming a strong software developer, gaining professional experience, and gradually moving deeper into Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Deep Learning.

My long-term goal is to build my own software house and use technology and AI to create useful, real-world software products.
